subject: Helios Labs — TIA scope, subprocessor map, and DPA procurement cadence
messages:
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@helioslabs.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Lucas Freeman <lucas.freeman@helioslabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TIA scope and subprocessor evidence needed for procurement

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — Helios is moving quickly on procurement and we need to lock a few things so our legal/procurement teams can progress. I attached a short requirements packet with priority asks, but the key items from our side are: 

- Full subprocessor map for all production services (including cloud providers / logging / cache layers)
- Confirmation whether Redwood's UK IDTA / UK Addendum applies for our EU customers (Helios has users in UK + EU)
- TIAs/DTIAs: what evidence you can provide (sample logs, data residency attestations, transferral safeguards) and expected timeline to hand over artifacts
- Any DPA redlines you will not accept (we need a short list so our legal knows where to escalate)

Can you share the map + a short note on which artifacts you can deliver by next Wednesday (2028-05-17)? Procurement has a monthly cutoff so we are on a tight timeline.

Attachments: Helios_TIA_requirements.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate it —
Emma Jenkins
Head of Procurement, Helios Labs
emma.jenkins@helioslabs.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Lucas Freeman <lucas.freeman@helioslabs.com>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TIA scope and subprocessor evidence needed for procurement

Hi Emma — thanks for the packet and for the heads-up on the procurement cutoff. Quick summary of next steps from our side and what we can commit to by 2028-05-17: 

1) Subprocessor map: attaching our current production subprocessor CSV (redwood_subprocessor_map_2028-04.csv). That includes cloud providers, logging, metrics, and our managed caching layer. Kimberly, can you confirm whether the cache vendor entry should include the replication region breakdown?
2) UK IDTA / UK Addendum: short answer — we support the UK Addendum; applicability depends on the DPA annex the customer signs (we'll surface exact clause references). Laura, please confirm whether we need to issue a formal UK Addendum letter for Helios or whether the standard DPA plus addendum checkbox suffices.
3) TIAs/DTIAs evidence: we can provide the following artifacts by next Wed: 
   - Signed SCCs/IDTA matrix (snapshot)
   - Sample truncated audit logs (redacted) for transfer events
   - Tech controls checklist and attestation (encryption at rest/in transit, HSM/KMS references)
We cannot provide customer raw logs; all samples will be redacted and scoped.
4) DPA redlines: attached a draft of typical non-starters and our standard list (see redlines_dpa_helios_v2.docx). If Helios has specific clauses, please mark them in the DocuSign link or call them out here.

Propose a 30-minute call Monday (2028-05-15) to walk procurement and legal through the artifacts and timelines. Lucas — can you confirm availability?

Thanks — Ill loop internal owners and push attachments now.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TIA scope and subprocessor evidence needed for procurement

Rishi / team — quick tech summary and where we stand on artifacts: 

- Subprocessor map: CSV attached. Note: caching layer is implemented with our managed in-memory store (Cacheco) in three regions. For Helios, we can provide a region-by-region residency statement; however Cacheco's logs are aggregated by region and we will only hand over aggregated, redacted samples as part of the TIA evidence.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest (customer keys in HSM via KMS integration for Dedicated/Private customers). TLS 1.3 in transit.
- Audit logs: we can produce redacted event traces focusing on transfer-related entries (service-to-service egress, onboarding key rotation, cross-region replication). Expect a sanitized bundle (~10MB) by 2028-05-17.
- UK Addendum: product behavior does not change; the addendum covers contractual protections. From a controls standpoint, nothing additional is required. Laura, please review the proposed addendum text we typically use for healthcare customers and flag any commercial exceptions.

Drive folder with evidence scaffolding: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Helios-TIA-evidence
Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_map_2028-04.csv (csv)

If Helios needs on-prem proof (e.g., for audit), we can scope a short evidence sprint; that will likely push timelines ~1-2 weeks depending on level of redaction/attestation required.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
